new_entities.name: InternationalTransfer
new_entities.description: Aggregate root for the international wire transfer lifecycle. Created by SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003) in PH-029 when PER-002 submits a transfer instruction. Tracks the transfer from initiation through compliance, SWIFT message assembly, nostro processing, and final settlement. Owned exclusively by SVC-010. The gpi_uetr field is the globally unique SWIFT gpi end-to-end reference visible in the SWIFT tracker and to the customer.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-010 at PH-029. Internal identifier. Immutable.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id (ENT-079). Immutable. PER-002 must be an authorised user on the linked BusinessAccount.

fields.name: business_account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessAccount.business_account_id (ENT-080). Originating account. Immutable.

fields.name: beneficiary_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–140 characters. SWIFT ISO 20022 structured creditor name. Must be actual beneficiary legal name — not a reference or trading name. Required for FATF travel rule compliance.

fields.name: beneficiary_iban
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 13616 IBAN. 15–34 characters. Validated against ISO 7064 MOD-97-10 check digit algorithm. Must match the beneficiary BIC's country context.

fields.name: beneficiary_bic
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 9362 BIC (8 or 11 characters). Validated against the SWIFT BIC directory at PH-029. Must be a live (not test) BIC.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places. Currency-denominated (see currency field). Must be > 0. Immutable after compliance clearance.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, CHF). Validated against the bank's supported currency list. Immutable.

fields.name: fx_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required for cross-currency transfers. GBP/foreign currency mid-market rate applied. 6 decimal places. Set to 1.000000 for GBP-denominated transfers. Immutable after FXQuotation acceptance.

fields.name: gbp_equivalent
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places. amount / fx_rate. Used for BusinessAccount debit, daily limit checking, and FATF travel rule GBP equivalent disclosure. Immutable after FXQuotation acceptance.

fields.name: purpose_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code (4-character code, e.g. SUPP = SupplierPayment, SALA = Salary, TRAD = TradeSettlement). Validated against SWIFT CBPR+ approved purpose code list. Included in pacs.008 message.

fields.name: charges_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: OUR | SHA | BEN. OUR = all charges borne by sender; SHA = shared between sender and beneficiary; BEN = all charges borne by beneficiary. Sourced from PER-002 selection at PH-029. Mapped to ISO 20022 ChargeBearerCode.

fields.name: swift_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set at PH-032. SWIFT message EndToEndId (max 35 characters, ISO 20022 compliant). Unique within the bank's SWIFT message namespace. Immutable after assignment.

fields.name: gpi_uetr
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set at PH-032. RFC 4122 UUID v4. SWIFT gpi Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference. Globally unique per SWIFT gpi rules. Displayed to customer in the portal tracker. Immutable after assignment.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_compliance | fx_pending | compliance_cleared | message_assembled | in_transit | processing_at_correspondent | credit_confirmed | completed | sanctions_blocked | fraud_blocked | failed | cancelled. State machine transitions enforced by SVC-010.

fields.name: initiated_by_user_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessAccount.authorised_users[].user_id. Records the portal user who initiated the transfer. Immutable. Required for dual-authorisation audit trail.

fields.name: second_authoriser_user_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → BusinessAccount.authorised_users[].user_id. Required when amount exceeds BusinessAccount.payment_approval_threshold. Records the second authoriser. Immutable after set.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on every status transition.

relationships.description: InternationalTransfer has at most one active FXQuotation. Multiple FXQuotation records may exist per transfer (lapsed + accepted), but only one can be in accepted status.
InternationalTransfer has one CorrespondentRouting record, created at PH-032.
InternationalTransfer has one SWIFTMessage record, created at PH-032.
InternationalTransfer belongs to one BusinessCustomer via business_customer_id.
InternationalTransfer is debited from one BusinessAccount via business_account_id.

design_decisions.decision: InternationalTransfer is a wholly new entity owned by SVC-010 (CAP-003). It does not extend or reference ENT-008 (PaymentIntent, owned by SVC-001/CAP-001) or ENT-009 (PaymentExecution, owned by SVC-009/CAP-003).
design_decisions.rationale: International transfers have a materially different lifecycle (FX quotation, SWIFT message assembly, correspondent routing, gpi tracking) that does not fit the FPS PaymentIntent model. Cross-capability entity reuse would violate the 'a service owns its entities exclusively' principle. The transfer's GBP equivalent is propagated to CAP-002 via an async event, not via a shared entity.

design_decisions.decision: beneficiary_iban and beneficiary_bic are stored on InternationalTransfer rather than referencing a Beneficiary entity.
design_decisions.rationale: A separate Beneficiary entity is appropriate for beneficiary management journeys (address book, pre-verified beneficiaries). For JRN-009, the beneficiary details are captured per-transfer. A dedicated Beneficiary management journey (JRN-014 placeholder) should introduce the Beneficiary entity when that capability is modelled.

new_entities.name: FXQuotation
new_entities.description: An FX rate quotation obtained by SVC-010 from the bank's FX pricing engine for a cross-currency international transfer. Created in PH-030. One or more FXQuotation records may exist per InternationalTransfer (if a quote lapses and is refreshed), but only one can have status = accepted at any time. The FXQuotation locks in the exchange rate and GBP equivalent for the BusinessAccount debit and FATF equivalent value reporting.

fields.name: quote_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → InternationalTransfer.transfer_id. Immutable.

fields.name: sell_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. For UK corporate transfers, always GBP (the originating account currency). Immutable.

fields.name: buy_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. Must equal InternationalTransfer.currency. Immutable.

fields.name: rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal. 6 decimal places. All-in rate inclusive of FX margin. GBP per 1 unit of buy_currency (e.g. GBP/USD rate = 1.270000 means 1 GBP buys 1.27 USD). Immutable after status = accepted.

fields.name: validity_seconds
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive integer. Duration in seconds for which the rate is guaranteed. Typically 30 for amounts > £1M (firm quote); 300 for indicative quotes on smaller amounts. The quote expires at created_at + validity_seconds.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_acceptance | accepted | lapsed | cancelled. Transitions: pending_acceptance → accepted (customer accepts); pending_acceptance → lapsed (validity_seconds exceeded); accepted → cancelled (transfer cancelled after acceptance).

fields.name: quoted_gbp_equivalent
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places. InternationalTransfer.amount / rate. GBP cost of the transfer at this quote rate. Immutable.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Quote validity is calculated as created_at + validity_seconds.

fields.name: accepted_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status transitions to accepted. Must be <= created_at + validity_seconds.

relationships.description: FXQuotation belongs to one InternationalTransfer via transfer_id.

design_decisions.decision: FXQuotation is a separate entity from InternationalTransfer rather than denormalised fields on the transfer.
design_decisions.rationale: A transfer may generate multiple quotations (lapsed then refreshed). An entity with its own lifecycle (status, validity window, created_at) is cleaner than arrays of quote fields on the transfer. The accepted quotation's rate is denormalised onto InternationalTransfer.fx_rate for the debit calculation.

new_entities.name: CorrespondentRouting
new_entities.description: Records the correspondent banking chain selected by SVC-010 for routing the SWIFT payment to the beneficiary bank. Created in PH-032 (SWIFT Message Assembly). The correspondent_chain is an ordered array of BICs through which the pacs.008 message will route. The nostro_account is the bank's account at the first correspondent in the chain, which will be debited for the transfer amount. Owned by SVC-010.

fields.name: routing_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → InternationalTransfer.transfer_id. Immutable.

fields.name: correspondent_chain
fields.validation_rule: Required. Ordered array of ISO 9362 BIC codes (8 or 11 characters each). Minimum 1 (direct correspondent). Maximum 5 (SWIFT gpi maximum hop count). Each BIC must be active in the SWIFT BIC directory. All BICs in this array are screened for sanctions in PH-031.

fields.name: nostro_account
fields.validation_rule: Required. The bank's nostro account number held at the first correspondent in correspondent_chain[0]. Account format varies by correspondent (IBAN for EEA correspondents; BBAN or proprietary for others). This account is debited by the transfer amount in PH-033.

fields.name: charges_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: OUR | SHA | BEN. Denormalised from InternationalTransfer.charges_type for SWIFT message construction. Maps to ISO 20022 ChargeBearerCode: OUR = DEBT, SHA = SHAR, BEN = CRED.

fields.name: routing_selected_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of routing selection by SVC-010. Immutable.

relationships.description: CorrespondentRouting belongs to one InternationalTransfer via transfer_id.

design_decisions.decision: correspondent_chain is an ordered array of BICs on CorrespondentRouting rather than a separate CorrespondentHop entity per bank.
design_decisions.rationale: The correspondent chain is determined at message assembly time and is immutable thereafter. An ordered array is sufficient for both SWIFT message construction and sanctions screening. A separate CorrespondentHop entity would add join complexity for no modelling benefit in JRN-009. If per-hop gpi status tracking is required in future (e.g. for a separate SWIFT gpi monitoring journey), CorrespondentHop can be introduced then.

new_entities.name: SWIFTMessage
new_entities.description: The SWIFT payment message record. Created by SVC-010 in PH-032 when the pacs.008 ISO 20022 MX message is assembled. Stores the message type, a reference to the raw payload (stored in the bank's secure document store rather than inline — raw_payload_ref is a pointer), submission timestamp, and the SWIFT acknowledgement timestamp. The message_type for JRN-009 is always pacs008 (MT103 is not supported per CBPR+ mandatory MX migration, November 2025). Owned by SVC-010.

fields.name: message_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Internal identifier. Immutable.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → InternationalTransfer.transfer_id. Immutable.

fields.name: message_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: MT103 | pacs008. For JRN-009, always pacs008. MT103 is included in the enum for legacy read compatibility only — it must not be set on new SWIFTMessage records created after CBPR+ MX cutover (November 2025).

fields.name: raw_payload_ref
fields.validation_rule: Required. Reference (URI or key) to the raw SWIFT message payload stored in the bank's encrypted document store (SVC-111 or equivalent). The raw pacs.008 XML is never stored inline in the entity record — this is a pointer. Immutable after submission.

fields.name: sent_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set at PH-033 when the message is submitted to the SWIFT network via SAA. Immutable after set.

fields.name: ack_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when the first correspondent bank acknowledges receipt of the pacs.008 via SWIFT gpi (ACSP — AcceptedSettlementInProcess). Immutable after set.

fields.name: swift_message_ref
fields.validation_rule: Required. The SWIFT MsgId from the pacs.008 GroupHeader (max 35 characters, ISO 20022 compliant). Unique within the bank's SWIFT message namespace. Distinct from InternationalTransfer.swift_reference (which is the EndToEndId). Immutable.

relationships.description: SWIFTMessage belongs to one InternationalTransfer via transfer_id.

design_decisions.decision: raw_payload_ref is a pointer to the stored message; the raw SWIFT XML is never stored as an inline field in the entity record.
design_decisions.rationale: SWIFT pacs.008 messages can be large (enriched with structured addresses, LEIs, purpose codes per CBPR+). Inline storage in the entity database would bloat the primary datastore. The pointer pattern keeps the entity lightweight while preserving the complete audit record per SWIFT gpi and FATF travel rule requirements.

design_decisions.decision: message_type enum includes MT103 for legacy read compatibility, but JRN-009 enforces pacs008 exclusively.
design_decisions.rationale: The bank may need to read historical SWIFTMessage records from pre-CBPR+ cutover (before November 2025) that carry message_type = MT103. Including MT103 in the enum prevents schema validation failures on read. New records must always be pacs008 — this is enforced at the service layer in SVC-010, not at the entity schema level.

referenced_existing_entities.name: BusinessCustomer
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: PER-002 (Corporate Client) must be an authorised user on a BusinessAccount belonging to this BusinessCustomer. SVC-010 validates business_customer_id at PH-029 initiation. The business_customer_id is stored on ENT-026 (InternationalTransfer) for audit and FATF travel rule originator identification. SVC-010 never writes to ENT-079.

referenced_existing_entities.name: BusinessAccount
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: The originating account for the international transfer. SVC-010 checks account status = active, available balance >= gbp_equivalent, and daily limit at PH-029. SVC-005 (CAP-002) owns the debit operation — SVC-010 triggers debit via async event (EVT-054 consumption). SVC-010 reads BusinessAccount.payment_approval_threshold to determine dual-authorisation requirement. SVC-010 never writes directly to ENT-080.
